notes: This contract pins the official C++ timestamped Update Attribute Values and Reflect Attribute Values callback declarations used by the bounded regional TSO scenario. It also records the official Time Advance Request, Retract, and Request Retraction surfaces used to establish grant/retraction boundaries. The shared recipient planner requires active overlapping regional attribute triples; passive triples remain retained without arranging reflection, although these timestamped cases do not independently test that selector. Focused ordinary TAR/NMR and explicit-source Time Constrained disable/re-enable companions now drive overlap-qualified regional passels to their grant frontiers and assert callback-before-grant ordering plus source-region metadata. A class-level regional Request Attribute Value Update companion now produces a timestamped response from the Provide callback and proves the same callback/grant ordering, retraction lifetime, and conveyed source-region set. Separate default-source companions drive ordinary/default-region passels to FQR, TARA, and NMRA and across a Time Constrained disable/re-enable transition; they verify the supplied-empty callback RegionHandleSet remains stable and the reflection is delivered exactly once before the post-re-enable grant. The Catch2 cases exercise one immediate recipient and one time-constrained recipient, including pending constrained-recipient suppression, Request Retraction for the delivered nonconstrained recipient, and recipient-gated sent-region metadata; a separate disjoint-region case proves the qualifying no-overlap returned-designator path. Focused immediate- and time-constrained-recipient callback-boundary cases commit an initially overlap-qualified subscriber region to the valid disjoint interval [2, 3] before dispatch. The immediate case confirms that the callback is absent and legal Retract does not manufacture Request Retraction; the time-constrained case receives only the matching grant and its producer-side strict boundary makes later Retract unavailable. A focused source-association replacement case proves that callback-time evaluation does not retarget an already queued passel to a replacement source association, while a subsequent passel uses the replacement region. The profile remains non-installable and does not claim complete default-region/re-enable coverage beyond these bounded companions, remote transport, save/restore persistence, package evidence, protected review, or conformance.
